name: Tang Yunshan
source:
[Spoiler]The Necromancer responsible for the vice governor's abduction.[/spoiler] Formerly a member of the Cheetah Special Operations group.

Fights using military-style Chinese martial arts, with a high-voltage blade and langxian as his primary weapons.

[From the in-game profile]
